segments.name: Dry bulk vessels
segments.description: Owns and bareboat chart in dry bulk vessels and employs them worldwide, mostly on short- to medium-term time charters.
segments.evidence: We specialize in the ownership and bareboat charter-in of dry bulk vessels, determined as one business segment.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay the company daily charter hire rates for vessels employed under time charter agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: Currently, the majority of our vessels are employed on short- to medium-term time charter agreements.
